title: Saw this and thought of you

caption:
Who came to mind first? Send this to them.

This one is about a God who is near, who is strong enough to save, and who is glad over the people He loves. Some days we need the reminder that we are delighted in, not just put up with.

Zephaniah 3:17 (BSB)

Keep this one close.
